classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Armored front-liner who holds enemies' attention and soaks up their blows.

kit.name: Taunt
kit.description: Forces the enemy to turn on you. On an enemy within 20 m.

kit.name: Bash
kit.description: Stuns for 1.5 s, interrupts a cast. On an enemy within 2.5 m.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Healer who mends wounds and wards allies, with a hallowed blow of their own.

kit.name: Minor Heal
kit.description: Heals 15-20. On an ally within 25 m.

kit.name: Smite
kit.description: Deals 10-14 holy damage. On an enemy within 25 m.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Quick melee striker: sneaks, backstabs, bleeds enemies and slips out of fights.

kit.name: Backstab
kit.description: Deals 12-18 physical damage. On an enemy within 2.5 m.

kit.name: Sneak
kit.description: Hides you until you act. On yourself.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Fragile caster with the strongest spells, from bolts of fire and frost to roots.

kit.name: Flame Dart
kit.description: Deals 8-12 fire damage. On an enemy within 25 m.

kit.name: Frost Bolt
kit.description: Deals 10-14 cold damage, slows by 40% for 12 s. On an enemy within 25 m.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Armored hybrid who fights at the front and can heal, cleanse and judge.

kit.name: Hallowed Blow
kit.description: Deals 8-12 holy damage, heals you for 50% of the damage you deal. On an enemy within 2.5 m.

kit.name: Challenge
kit.description: Forces the enemy to turn on you. On an enemy within 20 m.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Nature caster who heals over time, entangles and slows enemies, and poisons them.

kit.name: Thorn Bolt
kit.description: Deals 8-12 nature damage. On an enemy within 25 m.

kit.name: Mend
kit.description: Heals 14-18. On an ally within 25 m.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: Forces an enemy to turn on you, even from across the room. Use it to pull a mob off a friend who is taking the beating.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: A shield-first blow that stuns the enemy briefly and breaks off any spell it is casting. Use it when a caster starts to cast.

events.text: Tamsin Hale says: Welcome to Thornwick, friend. Hawthorn Square is the heart of the town, and the Watch keeps it. The trainers keep their halls along Trainers' Lane, one for every craft. The contract board stands here in the square, and the east gate leads out to the Downs. Captain Hartley is in the watch-house, if you want the Watch's work.

info.name: Taunt
info.description: Forces an enemy to turn on you, even from across the room. Use it to pull a mob off a friend who is taking the beating.

info.name: Bash
info.description: A shield-first blow that stuns the enemy briefly and breaks off any spell it is casting. Use it when a caster starts to cast.

info.name: Second Wind
info.description: For a short while, a share of the damage you deal comes back to you as health. Use it in the thick of a long fight.

info.name: Bulwark Stance
info.description: You plant your feet and take far less damage for a time. Use it before a hard hit, or against several foes at once.

info.name: Cleave
info.description: A wide swing that hits your target and one more enemy beside it. Use it when two foes are close together.

info.name: Rallying Shout
info.description: A roar that makes every enemy in the fight more eager to hit you. Use it to take control of a crowd.

info.name: Sunder
info.description: Chops at the enemy's armor, leaving it softer for everyone, and draws its anger. Use it early on a tough foe.

Gorran Stoutarm says: Stand your ground and the rest will follow. Show me you can take a hit. Taunt first, then bash. Everything else is patience. Open with Bash, keep Second Wind for long fights, and Taunt pulls a mob off a friend.
